body.p: The present application included claims 1-18 and 22-24. Claim 18 has been amended. Claims 1-17, 22 and 23 were canceled without prejudice or disclaimer. New claims 35-42 have been added.1
Claims 18 and 24 have been allowed. See October 7, 2024 Office Action at page 17.
Claims 11-13 were objected to due to informalities. The objections are moot in view of the claim amendments.
Claims 1-12 and 22 were rejected as being indefinite. These rejections are moot in view of the claim amendments.

Claims 1-6 and 9-17 were rejected as being unpatentable over U.S. 3,848,832 ("Stanley") in view of U.S. 2018/0113425 ("Nakashima"). Claims 7, 8, and 20 were rejected as being unpatentable over Stanley in view of Nakashima and U.S. 5,524,847 ("Brodell"). Claim 11 was rejected as being unpatentable over Stanley in view of Behzadpour and CN 201660965 ("Liu"). Claims 22 and 23 were rejected as being unpatentable over Stanley in view of Nakashima and U.S. 2016/0229545 ("Pautis").
The Applicant respectfully traverses these rejections for at least the reasons previously set forth during prosecution.

Nevertheless, in order to expedite prosecution toward allowance, the claims have been amended to render the rejections moot. New claims 25 and 35 recite limitations similar to those of allowed claim 18. As such, claims 25, 35, and the claims depending therefrom are also in condition for allowance.

The claims have been amended to expedite prosecution toward allowance. The claim amendments are not to be interpreted as an acknowledgement of the propriety of the claim rejections. The Applicant reserves the right to pursue the subject matter of the claims, as previously recited, in a continuation application.

In general, the Office Action makes various statements regarding the pending claims and the cited references that are now moot in light of the above. Thus, the Applicant will not address such statements at the present time. However, the Applicant expressly reserves the right to
1 No fee is believed due with respect to the new claims, the total number of pending claims does not exceed 20; nor does the total number of pending independent claims exceed 3.
challenge such statements in the future should the need arise (e.g., if such statements should become relevant by appearing in a rejection of any current or future claim).

The Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the claim rejections for at least the reasons discussed above. If the Examiner has any questions or the Applicant can be of any assistance, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney.
Respectfully Submitted, Date: December 2, 2024 /Joseph M. Butscher/
